nodes.description: TokenInfo.depositPrincipal: total deposit principal recorded for a user account.
TokenInfo.depositInterest: accrued deposit interest checkpoint for a user account.
TokenInfo.lastDepositBlock: block number of the last deposit checkpoint.
TokenInfo.borrowPrincipal: total borrow principal recorded for a user account.
TokenInfo.borrowInterest: accrued borrow interest checkpoint for a user account.
TokenInfo.lastBorrowBlock: block number of the last borrow checkpoint.
Constant BASE = 10**18 used as the fixed-point interest scaling factor.
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b): overflow-checked addition.
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b): underflow-checked subtraction wrapper.
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b, string errorMessage): underflow-checked subtraction with custom message.
SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b): overflow-checked multiplication with zero short circuit.
SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b): division wrapper reverting on zero divisor.
SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b, string errorMessage): division with custom revert message.
SafeMath.mod(uint256 a, uint256 b): modulo wrapper reverting on zero divisor.
SafeMath.mod(uint256 a, uint256 b, string errorMessage): modulo with custom revert message.
AccountTokenLib.getDepositPrincipal: view getter returning self.depositPrincipal.
AccountTokenLib.getBorrowPrincipal: view getter returning self.borrowPrincipal.
AccountTokenLib.getDepositBalance: returns principal plus calculated deposit interest.
AccountTokenLib.getBorrowBalance: returns principal plus calculated borrow interest.
AccountTokenLib.getLastDepositBlock: view getter returning self.lastDepositBlock.
AccountTokenLib.getLastBorrowBlock: view getter returning self.lastBorrowBlock.
AccountTokenLib.getDepositInterest: view getter returning self.depositInterest.
AccountTokenLib.getBorrowInterest: view getter returning self.borrowInterest.
AccountTokenLib.borrow: checkpoints borrow interest then increases borrowPrincipal by amount.
AccountTokenLib.withdraw: checkpoints deposit interest, then burns interest first and principal second.
AccountTokenLib.deposit: checkpoints deposit interest then increases depositPrincipal by amount.
AccountTokenLib.repay: checkpoints borrow interest, then repays interest first and principal second.
AccountTokenLib.newDepositCheckpoint: recomputes depositInterest and stores _block as lastDepositBlock.
AccountTokenLib.newBorrowCheckpoint: recomputes borrowInterest and stores _block as lastBorrowBlock.
AccountTokenLib.calculateDepositInterest: compound interest formula over deposit principal and prior interest.
AccountTokenLib.calculateBorrowInterest: compound interest formula over borrow principal with zero/low-rate guards.
Overflow-checked addition executed in SafeMath.add (require c >= a).
Underflow-checked subtraction executed in SafeMath.sub variants (require b <= a).
Overflow-checked multiplication executed in SafeMath.mul (require c / a == b).
Zero-divisor guarded division executed in SafeMath.div variants.
Compound arithmetic chain in calculateDepositInterest: add, mul, sub, div over scaled principal.
Compound arithmetic chain in calculateBorrowInterest: add, mul, sub, div guarded by rate/balance checks.
Interest-then-principal accounting arithmetic in withdraw, including saturating zero-out branch.
Interest-then-principal accounting arithmetic in repay, including saturating zero-out branch.
Zero-divisor guarded modulo executed in SafeMath.mod variants.
self: storage pointer to the per-user TokenInfo struct.
amount: value to deposit, withdraw, borrow or repay.
accruedRate: scaled interest rate index supplied to the checkpoint functions.
_block: block number recorded as the new checkpoint height.
a: first operand of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers.
b: second operand of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers.
errorMessage: custom revert string passed through the 3-argument SafeMath wrappers.
c: local result of the checked addition/multiplication inside SafeMath.
_balance: local copy of self.borrowPrincipal read in calculateBorrowInterest.

edges.reason: self storage pointer is passed into borrow to read and write the user TokenInfo.
amount is added to borrowPrincipal inside borrow.
self storage pointer is passed into withdraw to mutate deposit balances.
amount flows into the withdraw interest/principal reduction logic.
self storage pointer is passed into deposit.
amount is added to depositPrincipal inside deposit.
self storage pointer is passed into repay.
amount is subtracted from borrow balances inside repay.
accruedRate is used by newDepositCheckpoint to recompute deposit interest.
_block is stored as the new lastDepositBlock by newDepositCheckpoint.
accruedRate is used by newBorrowCheckpoint to recompute borrow interest.
_block is stored as the new lastBorrowBlock by newBorrowCheckpoint.
operand a flows into SafeMath.add.
operand b flows into SafeMath.add.
operand a flows into SafeMath.mul.
operand b flows into SafeMath.mul.
operand a flows into SafeMath.div.
operand b flows into SafeMath.div.
errorMessage is forwarded to the 3-argument SafeMath.sub revert.
local c receives the raw a + b result before the overflow require in SafeMath.add.
_balance caches self.borrowPrincipal before the compound interest arithmetic.
depositPrincipal is read into the calculateDepositInterest formula.
depositInterest is added to principal inside the interest formula.
BASE scaling factor is multiplied and divided within calculateDepositInterest.
borrowPrincipal is read into the calculateBorrowInterest formula.
borrowInterest is added to principal inside the borrow interest formula.
BASE scaling factor participates in the borrow interest arithmetic and guard.
getDepositPrincipal returns the depositPrincipal state variable.
getBorrowPrincipal returns the borrowPrincipal state variable.
getLastDepositBlock returns the lastDepositBlock state variable.
getLastBorrowBlock returns the lastBorrowBlock state variable.
getDepositInterest returns the depositInterest state variable.
getBorrowInterest returns the borrowInterest state variable.
borrow writes the increased amount into borrowPrincipal.
deposit writes the increased amount into depositPrincipal.
withdraw reduces depositPrincipal when interest is insufficient.
withdraw reduces depositInterest first.
repay reduces borrowPrincipal when interest is insufficient.
repay reduces borrowInterest first.
newDepositCheckpoint overwrites depositInterest with the recalculated value.
newDepositCheckpoint stores _block into lastDepositBlock.
newBorrowCheckpoint overwrites borrowInterest with the recalculated value.
newBorrowCheckpoint stores _block into lastBorrowBlock.
borrow calls newBorrowCheckpoint before increasing principal.
withdraw calls newDepositCheckpoint before reducing balances.
deposit calls newDepositCheckpoint before increasing principal.
repay calls newBorrowCheckpoint before reducing balances.
newDepositCheckpoint delegates interest computation to calculateDepositInterest.
newBorrowCheckpoint delegates interest computation to calculateBorrowInterest.
getDepositBalance calls calculateDepositInterest to report the live balance.
getBorrowBalance calls calculateBorrowInterest to report the live debt.
borrow uses SafeMath.add to increase borrowPrincipal.
deposit uses SafeMath.add to increase depositPrincipal.
withdraw uses SafeMath.sub to reduce interest and principal.
repay uses SafeMath.sub to reduce interest and principal.
calculateDepositInterest adds principal and interest via SafeMath.add.
calculateDepositInterest scales values with SafeMath.mul.
calculateDepositInterest subtracts the scaled principal via SafeMath.sub.
calculateDepositInterest normalizes the result with SafeMath.div.
calculateBorrowInterest scales values with SafeMath.mul.
calculateBorrowInterest subtracts the scaled principal via SafeMath.sub.
calculateBorrowInterest normalizes the result with SafeMath.div.
SafeMath.sub overload forwards to the 3-argument implementation.
SafeMath.div overload forwards to the 3-argument implementation.
SafeMath.mod overload forwards to the 3-argument implementation.
SafeMath.add performs the overflow-checked addition operation.
SafeMath.sub wrapper leads to the underflow-checked subtraction.
SafeMath.sub 3-arg body executes the underflow-checked subtraction.
SafeMath.mul performs the overflow-checked multiplication.
SafeMath.div wrapper leads to the zero-checked division.
SafeMath.div 3-arg body executes the zero-checked division.
SafeMath.mod wrapper leads to the zero-checked modulo.
SafeMath.mod 3-arg body executes the zero-checked modulo.
calculateDepositInterest executes the compound interest arithmetic chain.
calculateBorrowInterest executes the guarded compound interest arithmetic chain.
withdraw executes the interest-then-principal accounting arithmetic.
repay executes the interest-then-principal accounting arithmetic.

normalization_plan.reason: The storage pointer self is only meaningful relative to the TokenInfo mutator that consumes it; fold it into borrow as the representative core function.
The user supplied amount parameter is consumed directly by borrow to grow borrowPrincipal.
accruedRate exists solely to drive the interest formula, so it normalizes onto calculateDepositInterest.
_block is only written as the checkpoint height, so it normalizes onto newDepositCheckpoint.
The first arithmetic operand a normalizes onto the SafeMath.add helper that consumes it.
The second arithmetic operand b normalizes onto the SafeMath.add helper that consumes it.
The revert string only matters for the 3-argument SafeMath.sub wrapper that emits it.
The local result c exists only to be validated by the overflow check, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
The cached _balance exists only as an operand of the borrow interest arithmetic chain.
